nodes.question: What effect does a reduction in temperature difference have on thermal mixing quality?
nodes.answer: A reduction in temperature difference results in improved thermal mixing quality.
nodes.paragraph: [ 23] discovered that thermal mixing occurs more rapidly over a shorter distance when the branch pipe isinclined at angles of 45 and 60 . However, mixing is slower when the inclination angle of the mixing tee is 30 or 90 . Additionally, it has been observed that for inclination anglesof 45 and 60 , the average temperature follows a linear trend, indicating a lack of variation at the shortest distance along the central axis of the main pipe. In their study, Fenget al. [ 24] discovered that the mixing temperature remains relatively constant with minimal uctuations in temperature for both downward injection (DI) and horizontal injection(HI) in a 45 mixing tee. However, they observed thatthe temperature uctuation is signi cantly higher in a 90 mixing tee compared to the 45 tee. The difference in inlet temperature is determined by the variation in temperatureand the quality of thermal mixing. A reduction in tempera- ture difference results in improved thermal mixing quality, whereas an increase in intake uid temperature differenceleads to a loss in mixing performance. Chen et al. nodes.question: What were some of the best available technologies used to enhance the old manufacturing system?
nodes.answer: Six of the best available technologies used to enhance the old manufacturing system included wastewater heat recovery, reusable cooling water, reactive dyes, low/unsalted dyeing processes, steam, and thermal oil pipeline transformation, exhaust gas heat recovery, alkali recovery and reuse via nanofiltration membrane, and efficient evaporation.
